faq_heading: Abbotsford commercial real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Commercial property for sale in Abbotsford: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. This search shows properties for sale only; spaces for lease are not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
In the second quarter of 2026, 18 commercial properties sold in Abbotsford (against 19 a year earlier), worth $79.5M in all: 4 industrial, 6 land, 1 office, 5 retail and other, and 2 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Abbotsford submarket (10.7M sq ft) was 4.5% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $17.12 per sq ft net plus $5.73 in additional rent, with 142,400 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Zoning decides what a commercial property can be used for. These are the Abbotsford zones on the zoning guide; each links to its permitted uses, smallest new lot and height limits. Check the zone of a specific address before you buy.
